2	  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
3	  "$id": "https://openvela.contest/schema/event.schema.json",
4	  "title": "Contest Session Log Event",
5	  "description": "openvela AI Contest session log single-event schema (v1.0). Each JSONL line MUST satisfy this schema.",
6	  "type": "object",
7	  "required": [
8	    "schema_version",
9	    "session_id",
10	    "team_id",
11	    "github_login",
12	    "tool",
13	    "ts",
14	    "role",
15	    "seq"
16	  ],
17	  "additionalProperties": true,
18	  "properties": {
19	    "schema_version": {
20	      "type": "string",
21	      "description": "Schema version. Initial release fixed at 1.0.",
22	      "enum": ["1.0"]
23	    },
24	    "session_id": {
25	      "type": "string",
26	      "description": "Internal session ID from the AI tool, e.g. ses_xxx.",
27	      "minLength": 1
28	    },
29	    "team_id": {
30	      "type": "string",
31	      "description": "Team ID (e.g. contest2026-042-app), provided via TEAM_ID env var.",
32	      "minLength": 1,
33	      "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$"
34	    },
35	    "github_login": {
36	      "type": "string",
37	      "description": "GitHub username identifying the specific producer (team member) of this event.",
38	      "minLength": 1,
39	      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38}$"
40	    },
41	    "tool": {
42	      "type": "string",
43	      "description": "Source AI tool.",
44	      "enum": ["opencode", "claude-code", "codex", "kiro"]
45	    },
46	    "ts": {
47	      "type": "string",
48	      "description": "ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred.",
49	      "format": "date-time"
50	    },
51	    "role": {
52	      "type": "string",
53	      "description": "Event role.",
54	      "enum": ["user", "assistant", "tool", "system"]
55	    },
56	    "seq": {
57	      "type": "integer",
58	      "description": "Per-session monotonic sequence number starting at 0, incremented by 1 per event. Used for resume + tamper detection.",
59	      "minimum": 0
60	    },
61	    "text": {
62	      "type": "string",
63	      "description": "Text content for user / assistant / system events. Preserved in full, no truncation."
64	    },
65	    "thinking": {
66	      "type": "string",
67	      "description": "Assistant extended thinking / reasoning content (when exposed by the tool)."
68	    },
69	    "tool_name": {
70	      "type": "string",
71	      "description": "(Required when role=tool) Tool name, e.g. read / edit / bash."
72	    },
73	    "tool_call_id": {
74	      "type": "string",
75	      "description": "(Required when role=tool) Unique tool invocation ID."
76	    },
77	    "input": {
78	      "description": "(role=tool only) Tool arguments. Kept as a structured object, not serialized into a string.",
79	      "type": ["object", "array", "string", "number", "boolean", "null"]
80	    },
81	    "output": {
82	      "description": "(role=tool only) Tool return value.",
83	      "type": ["object", "array", "string", "number", "boolean", "null"]
84	    },
85	    "model": {
86	      "type": "string",
87	      "description": "(Optional) Model name in use."
88	    },
89	    "tokens_in": {
90	      "type": "integer",
91	      "minimum": 0,
92	      "description": "(Optional) Input token count. Required for token-plan upgrade audits."
93	    },
94	    "tokens_out": {
95	      "type": "integer",
96	      "minimum": 0,
97	      "description": "(Optional) Output token count."
98	    },
99	    "files_touched": {
100	      "type": "array",
101	      "items": { "type": "string" },
102	      "description": "(Optional) List of file paths read/written during this event."
103	    },
104	    "cwd": {
105	      "type": "string",
106	      "description": "(Optional) The plugin's working directory at the time of the event."
107	    },
108	    "metadata": {
109	      "type": "object",
110	      "description": "(Optional) Tool execution metadata (timing, exit code, etc.)."
111	    },
112	    "redacted_count": {
113	      "type": "integer",
114	      "minimum": 0,
115	      "description": "(Optional) Number of redaction substitutions applied to this event, for audit."
116	    }
117	  },
118	  "allOf": [
119	    {
120	      "description": "When role=tool, tool_name and tool_call_id MUST be present.",
121	      "if": {
122	        "properties": { "role": { "const": "tool" } }
123	      },
124	      "then": {
125	        "required": ["tool_name", "tool_call_id"]
126	      }
127	    }
128	  ]
129	}

5	
6	# Contest Log Collector — openvela AI 大赛 AI Coding 日志归集
7	
8	为 openvela AI 大赛提供 AI Coding 日志归集能力,**工作区感应、对话结束自动入仓**。
9	
10	## 核心架构
11	
12	```
13	       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
14	       │ 门控: 当前目录向上能找到 .repo/ ?                    │
15	       │   否 → 不在 openvela 工作区 → 完全不采集             │
16	       │   是 → 在 openvela 工作区 → 进入采集                 │
17	       └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
18	                               │ (在工作区内)
19	                               ↓
20	       ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
21	       │ 对话结束自动写入: demo 仓 logs/<login>/              │
22	       │ 只写文件,不自动 commit/push                         │
23	       │ 选手 git push 时跟代码一起上 GitHub                  │
24	       └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
25	```
26	
27	**关键安全特性**: 用"是否在 openvela 工作区(`.repo/`)内"作为隐私门控 —— 选手在个人项目(工作区外)跟 AI 聊的对话**完全不采集**;只有在比赛工作区内的对话才会自动写入选手仓 `logs/`,且工具自身**永远不会 git push**,上传由选手控制。
28	
29	## 自动入仓(默认,无需操作)
30	
31	在 openvela 工作区内跟 AI 工具(Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex)对话,会话结束时日志会**自动写入**选手仓的 `logs/<github_login>/`。选手只需在提交代码时一起 push:
32	
33	```bash
34	git add logs/
35	git commit -s -m "logs: capture session"
36	git push
37	```
38	
39	## (可选)手动补导
40	
41	正常流程不需要,但你可以用手动工具查看清单或补导某次会话。
42	
43	### 1. 短命令 `contest-snapshot`(`install.sh` 装在 `~/.local/bin/`)
44	
45	```bash
46	# 列出本机已采集的所有 session
47	contest-snapshot --list
48	
49	# 补导某个 session (加 --confirm 真写入)
50	contest-snapshot --session <session-id> --confirm
51	
52	# 按日期补导
53	contest-snapshot --today --confirm
54	contest-snapshot --since 2026-06-15 --confirm
55	```
56	
57	### 2. 完整路径 fallback(`~/.local/bin` 不在 PATH 时)
58	
59	```bash
60	python3 ../.claude/skills/contest-log-collector/tools/export-session.py --list
61	```
62	
63	### 3. 自然语言 / Slash command
64	
65	对 AI 说"补导这次会话",或在 Claude Code 里跑 `/contest-snapshot`,AI 会调用 `export-session.py` 预览,确认后加 `--confirm` 写入。
66	
67	> ⚠️ 手动工具的 `--confirm`:不加时只预览不写文件。手动补导仅用于补救/管理,正常对话已自动入仓。

126	## 数据契约
127	
128	JSONL 每条事件必含字段:
129	
130	- `schema_version` — 当前 1.0
131	- `session_id` — AI 工具内部 session ID
132	- `team_id` — 对应仓库的官方匿名编号
133	- `github_login` — 当前组员 GitHub username
134	- `tool` — opencode / claude-code / codex / kiro
135	- `seq` — session 内单调递增(防作弊核心)
136	- `ts` — ISO 8601 UTC 时间戳
137	- `role` — user / assistant / tool / system
138	
139	## 安全特性
140	
141	- **工作区门控**: 只在 openvela 工作区(向上能找到 `.repo/`)内采集,工作区外的对话(含个人项目)完全不采集
142	- **不自动上传**: 自动入仓只写本机仓内 `logs/` 文件,工具自身从不 `git push`,上传由选手控制
143	- **自动脱敏**: 默认正则覆盖 `sk-*` (API key) / `ghp_*` (GitHub token) / `Bearer *` (auth header)
144	- **TEAM_ID 缺失主动拒绝**: 防止数据归属错乱
145	- **多人组天然安全**: 按 `<github_login>/` 一人一目录,组员之间互不干扰
146

import json, glob, re

patterns = [
    (r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}', '[REDACTED_GITHUB_TOKEN]'),
    (r'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{48}', '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'),

    (r'(password[\"\':\s]+)[A-Za-z0-9!@#\$%\^&\*]{8,}', r'\1[REDACTED]'),
    (r'-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----[^\-]+-----END (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----', '[REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY]'),
    (r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}', '[REDACTED_AWS_KEY]'),
    (r'ark-[a-f0-9\-]{20,}', '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'),
]

count = 0
redacted_total = 0
for f in glob.glob('./logs/arclau/**/*.jsonl', recursive=True):
    with open(f, 'r') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    
    original = content
    for pattern, replacement in patterns:
        content, n = re.subn(pattern, replacement, content)
        redacted_total += n
    
    if content != original:
        with open(f, 'w') as fh:
            fh.write(content)
        count += 1

print(f'脱敏完成: {count} 个文件, {redacted_total} 处替换')
